title: Expanding from nine to fourteen pieces in Chicago
summary: At the Grand Terrace the band expanded, but some new men could not read, so Basie replaced them with Dickie Wells and Benny Morton.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: : Well, when you get to New York when is it the band gets sort of expanded up?
Oh, that was for the Grand Terrace?

Yes, we went from nine to fourteen in there. And it sounded like hell because we didn't even know it, some of the guys wasn't reading. They (some) couldn't read. We didn't know that. We thought they were reading until later on we found out they were faking their parts and Basie had to keep changing. That's why he got Dickie and Benny Morton and all of us.
